payload.claim: `_NON_CELL_PHASES` restates the literal `"SPEC_WRITING"` instead of importing `spec_review.WRITING_PHASE`. The repository already has exactly this constant and already imports it for the same purpose: `saffron/task.py:1134` builds `_NOT_THIS_CELLS_PHASE = frozenset({"SPEC_REVIEW", spec_review.WRITING_PHASE})`. Per the one-source rule, a constant the repo already defines must be imported rather than restated, even when the restated value agrees with the original today.
